title: Grade on the head. Count in the crate.
lede: Hakimi Fastners supplies nuts, bolts, screws, and nails the way a store issues them: marked, sized, and counted. No mixed handfuls. No mystery mill.
heroImageAlt: Hex bolts and nuts in a packing bay

story.title: Real people count every bag before it leaves.
story.body: We supply four product lines only — bolts, nuts, screws, and nails. That keeps your drawing, store bin, and packing list aligned.
points: Each size and grade is marked clearly on the head or bag.
Bolts and nuts are matched as pairs, not mixed from different mills.
Every crate is counted in Gandhinagar before dispatch.
story.pull: When you open the bag on site, the next piece should be the same as the last.
story.mediaAlt: Workers counting and packing fasteners in Gandhinagar

process.title: How your lot is prepared
process.lede: From raw wire to a labelled bag — four clear checks before anything leaves our bay.

steps.title: Pick the right wire
steps.body: We know the coil and heat lot before heading or drawing starts. No shared mystery stock.

steps.title: Make the thread
steps.body: Bolts are rolled, nuts are tapped, screws are pointed, and nails are drawn to the size on your list.

steps.title: Mark the grade
steps.body: 8.8, 10.9, stainless — the head shows what is inside the bag. If it is not marked, it is not sold.

steps.title: Count and pack
steps.body: Kilograms, pieces, or sets. The packing list must match the bag, or the bag stays on the bay.

lines.title: Four lines. Everything a site store needs.
lines.lede: Standard fasteners for fabrication, construction, and maintenance — not a mixed catalogue.

items.name: Bolts
items.body: Hex bolts and anchor bolts in common grades and sizes. Marked heads, ready for site and steel work.

items.name: Nuts
items.body: Hex and nylon-lock nuts paired to the bolt size. No leftover mill mix in the same bag.

items.name: Screws
items.body: Machine screws and self-tapping screws for sheet metal, panels, and assembly work.

items.name: Nails
items.body: Wire nails and concrete nails for timber and masonry — counted and packed for the store.

promise.title: A bin you can trust on a Monday morning.

items.title: One mill per bag
items.body: We do not top up a short count with another coil.

items.title: Finish you asked for
items.body: Zinc, black, or galvanized — written on the ticket, not guessed at the gate.

items.title: Packed for stores
items.body: Issue it like a storekeeper, not like a catalogue essay.

desk.title: Talk to the desk, not a call centre.
desk.lede: If a count is short or a thread does not fit, you reach the people who run the house — not a ticket queue.

people.crunch: Sales, standards, and what leaves the gate.
people.body: Leads product selection, customer lots, and quality calls. Your enquiry lands here first.
Handles finance, vendor payments, and the numbers behind every crate.
